name: the village square
description: A patch of trampled earth at the heart of Brackenford, ringed by the tavern, the bakery, the smithy and a few cottages. A cart with a broken wheel has stood in one corner for weeks.
affordances: sit on the edge of the cart
appearance: An open patch of trampled earth ringed by buildings, with a broken-down cart in one corner.

name: the Tilted Cup
description: A low-ceilinged tavern that smells of smoke and spilled ale. A crooked doorframe gives the place its name. A few scarred tables, a hearth, and a counter with a row of barrels behind it.
appearance: A squat timber building with a crooked doorframe. Smoke rises from its chimney and you hear voices inside.

food.description: stew and bread from the kitchen

name: the bakery
description: A warm, cramped room in front of a big brick oven. Flour sacks are stacked against the back wall next to a locked storeroom door. Loaves cool on wooden racks by the window.
appearance: A narrow shop with a big brick chimney. The smell of fresh bread drifts out of its door.

food.description: bread and buns from the racks

name: the smithy
description: An open-fronted workshop with a soot-black forge, an anvil worn smooth in the middle, and tools hanging from every beam. It is loud and hot when the forge is lit.
appearance: An open-fronted workshop. You hear hammering and see the red glow of a forge.

name: the village well
description: A round stone well with a wooden roof and a creaking winch, just off the square. The ground around it is always muddy. A worn bench stands beside it.
appearance: A round stone well under a little wooden roof, with a bench beside it.

name: Greta's house
description: A narrow, tidy house behind the bakery. Everything is in its place; a ledger of who owes what lies on the kitchen table.
appearance: A narrow, tidy house tucked behind the bakery.

name: Tomas's house
description: A dark, sparsely furnished cottage next to the smithy. It smells of iron and old smoke. Jonas sleeps on a cot in the back room.
appearance: A dark little cottage beside the smithy, its shutters closed.

bed.description: a hard bed and a cot in the back room

name: Lena's house
description: A small cottage full of drying herbs hanging from the rafters, jars on every shelf, and a pot that is always simmering on the hearth.
appearance: A small cottage with bundles of herbs hanging under its eaves.

name: the old mine entrance
description: A timbered mouth in the hillside behind the smithy, half choked with bramble. Cold air breathes out of it. Rusted cart rails vanish into the dark, and the props groan when the wind turns.
appearance: A dark, timbered opening in the hillside, half hidden by bramble.
affordances: pick through the old spoil heap

name: the chapel yard
description: A quiet fenced yard behind the old chapel at the north-west edge of the village, under a great old yew. Grass grows long between the graves; the chapel steps are worn hollow.
appearance: A fenced yard with a stone chapel front and a great dark yew tree.

burial.description: ground where the dead are buried
